description: This file defines classes and functions for collecting, managing, and reporting metrics during compilation and runtime within the Dynamo system. It includes context managers for metrics collection, a helper class for top N metrics, and external references to traceback utilities.

classes.name: TopN
classes.description: Helper class to record and keep only the top N most expensive metrics.

classes.name: MetricsContext
classes.description: Context manager for collecting and reporting metrics during compilation.

classes.name: RuntimeMetricsContext
classes.description: Context for collecting runtime metrics decoupled from compilation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add a metric to the TopN list, maintaining only the top N.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Return the number of metrics in TopN.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Iterate over the metrics in descending order of value.

methods.name: MetricsContext.__init__
methods.description: Initialize the metrics collection context with an on_exit callback.

methods.name: MetricsContext.__enter__
methods.description: Start metrics collection, recording start time.

methods.name: MetricsContext.__exit__
methods.description: End metrics collection and invoke on_exit callback.

methods.name: MetricsContext.in_progress
methods.description: Check if metrics collection is currently active.

methods.name: MetricsContext.increment
methods.description: Increment a specific metric by a given value.

methods.name: MetricsContext._render_edits
methods.description: Render previous traceback edits for a metric.

methods.name: MetricsContext.set
methods.description: Set a metric to a specific value, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: MetricsContext.set_key_value
methods.description: Set a key-value pair within a metric treated as a dictionary.

methods.name: MetricsContext.update_outer
methods.description: Update metrics only at the outermost context.

methods.name: MetricsContext.add_to_set
methods.description: Add a value to a set-type metric.

methods.name: MetricsContext.add_top_n
methods.description: Add a metric to a TopN list.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsContext.__init__
methods.description: Initialize runtime metrics context with an on_exit callback.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsContext.increment
methods.description: Increment a runtime metric, optionally adding extra key-value pairs.
